description: This file is a shell test script for verifying internationalization (i18n) settings and formatting in Git, including testing encoding conversions, patch creation, rebasing, cherry-picking, and applying patches with different character encodings.

methods.name: check_encoding
methods.description: Checks that the commit encodings and log output encodings are correctly handled by creating patches and using git commands. It verifies character content and encoding in the generated patches.
